rows.note: Use 政治 as the all-purpose noun for government affairs and the political activity surrounding an organization or movement.

example.english: I hate office politics because they make everyone lose the motivation to work.
example.traditional: 我最怕公司入面啲政治，搞到大家冇心機做嘢。
